Scorching landing After flying with your jetpack, you can choose to land (losing all the remaining flying speed) and burst fire in a 5-foot radius. All creatures (except you) in this area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or receive Burning for one turn. Flood of fire A range weapon without the surgical property You can use your action and one use of your jetpack to rise and to rain down fire in a 10-foot radius. Roll your weapon damage one time. Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes the full damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage with a burst weapon a rolled one time. The weapon overheat increase by the maximal amount of its cooling action. Brutal landing 12 Constitution After flying with your jetpack, you can choose to land (losing all the remaining flying speed) and burst fire in a 5-foot radius. All creatures (except you) in this area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. Reflex Dodge 12 Dexterity If you are in the area of an explosion or other similar effects, you can use your reaction and one use of your jetpack to fly out from the danger. You only move to the closest safe area. Clearance You can use a use of your jetpack to give you +5 to your next saving throw against any restraining condition.

docs.title: Jetpack master
docs.text: At 10th level, you increase your jetpack flying speed by 20ft. Moreover, you gain a fifth use of the jetpack between two short rests and learn a second maneuver.

docs.title: Faster than light
docs.text: At 15th level you are so fast with your jetpack, enemies do not have time to react. When flying with your jetpack you always dodge overwatch and opportunity attacks if they can miss. Moreover you gain a sixth use of the jetpack and dont need a bonus action anymore to fly. You learn a third maneuver.

docs.title: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No. It's an air trooper
docs.text: At 18th level, you increase your jetpack flying speed by 20 feet, have ten uses of the jetpack, and learn a fourth maneuver.

docs.title: Soldier: Artillery
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Artillery trained
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with rocket launchers, miniguns, precision rifles and bombs.

docs.title: Overloaded
docs.text: At 7th level, you gain an amount of Gadget Points equal to your level. Moreover you gain an additional gadget choice.

docs.title: Guilty pleasure
docs.text: At 10th level, choose one gadget you are proficient with. The DC of this gadget is increased by 1. This gadget gp cost is reduced by 1.

docs.title: Lethal technology
docs.text: At 15th level, when you roll gadget damage, you can reroll all 1.

docs.title: Better too much than not enough
docs.text: At 18th level, all your explosion radius are increased by 5 feet.

docs.title: Bounty Hunter: Assassin
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Uncanny eye
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with all precision rifles Moreover, your ranged attacks ignore an enemy's half cover.

docs.title: Dread Ambusher
docs.text: At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier. At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, which lasts until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type.

docs.title: Favored enemy
docs.text: At 6th level, you become good at focusing a specific target. At the start of your first turn of each combat, you designate your favored enemy. Until the end of the combat, any attack roll you do against your favored enemy deals bonus damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Chained shots
docs.text: At 9th level, you can use your action to make a ranged attack against creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon’s range. You make a separate attack roll for each target. This action can target a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus.

docs.title: Stalker's Flurry
docs.text: At 11th level, you learn to attack with such unexpected speed that you can turn a miss into another strike. Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

docs.title: Lethal strike
docs.text: At 17th level, if you are not in combat, you can make an attack against a target who is unaware of your presence. If you hit, this attack is automatically a critical hit. You must not have disadvantage on the attack. Once you use this feature, you can't use it until a short rest.

docs.title: Soldier: Body Guard
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Guardian
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with defibrillators, all ionic shields, deployable barriers, and ionic domes. Moreover when a creature in a 5ft range from you get hit by an attack and you are using a shield, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage taken according to the shield used. Shield | Damage reduction --------------------|----------------- Small shield | 1d4 + Constitution modifier Riot shield | 1d6 + Constitution modifier Small ionic shield | up to shield Hit Points Medium ionic shield | up to shield Hit Points Riot ionic shield | up to shield Hit Points If you use this feature with an ionic shield, it uses the ionic shield's Hit Points in the same way as for yourself.

docs.title: War colossus
docs.text: At 7th level, while wearing heavy armor, you have advantage on Athletics checks to grapple a creature, and you don't get a penalty for grappling a creature one size bigger than you. Moreover, if you have to carry a creature, you don't get penalty to your walking speed. Any creature in 5ft from you benefit from a half cover.

docs.title: Overclocked batteries
docs.text: At 10th level, all your ionic barriers, such as ionic shield, deployable barrier or ionic dome maximum Hit Points are increased by your Wisdom modifier bonus * your proficiency bonus.

docs.title: Exceptional constitution
docs.text: At 15th level, your Hit Points increase by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier bonus * your proficiency bonus. Moreover you have advantage on saving throws against something trying to push you or knock you prone.

docs.title: Impenetrable
docs.text: At 18th level, any creature in 5ft from you benefit from a three quarter cover. Additionally, the Protector feature doesn't consume your reaction anymore.

docs.title: Force Sensitive: Dathomir
docs.text:
Everything you learned comes from Allya, the mother of Dathomir.

Your character story must align with the practices of the Dathomiri society.

Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Dathomiri Practices
docs.text:
The practitioners of Dathomir Magic believed themselves to be casting spells rather than making use of the Force, and often were unable to make use of a "spell" without speaking its assigned name or performing the ritualized singing, dancing, chanting, and/or writing associated with it. The Nightsisters often attributed the work of the Force to the Spirits instead.

You learned to use the Force from the Dathomir witches. Choose one clan of Dathomir: if you choose the Nightsisters, use the alternative features. Whenever the Force Sensitive class mentions Wisdom, replace it with Charisma. You have advantage on any skill rolls involving rancors.

docs.title: Allyan Magic
docs.text:
At 5th level, the following Force tricks are added to your Force tricks table. When you take this feature, you can replace any of your Force tricks with the ones in this table.

Trick Casting time Effect Healing Bonus Action You touch yourself or another creature. It recover 1 Force Die + your charisma modifier hit points. Guardian Aura Action Any creature you choose in your range including you gain 1 Force Die in temporary hit points. Bless Bonus action You gift a part of your Force to 1 creature you choose (except yourself). This creature can consume this gift to have a bonus equal to one of your Force Die to an ability check, saving throw or attack roll. The gift is lost if the creature takes a long rest. Invisible Hand Reaction When you see a creature failing a Dexterity or Strength saving throw or skill check, you can roll 1 Force Die and give it a bonus equal to half the amount.

docs.title: Night Spells (NightSisters)
docs.text:
At 5th level, your Force tricks are totally corrupted by the NightSisters practices: all your Force tricks now deal necrotic damage. Moreover, the following Force tricks are added to your Force tricks table. When you take this feature, you can replace any of your Force tricks with the ones in this table.

Trick Casting time Effect Force Drain Action You target a creature in your range, then you touch yourself or another creature. The target takes 1 Force Die + your Charisma modifier necrotic damage, and the creature you touch recover half the amount of hit points. Night touch Action You point at one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed a Charisma saving throw or take 1 Force Die necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it can't recover any hit points until the end of his next turn. Bane Action You point at one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed a Charisma saving throw or have a penalty equal to one of your Force Die to his attacks rolls for 1 turn. Cursed spirit Bonus Action You make eye contact with one organic creature you can see within range. The target must succeed a Charisma saving throw or being cursed until the end of your turn. When a cursed target die, a green spirit rise from its body and hurl to the closest creature hostile to you in 30ft, dealing 1 Force Die damage and repeating this trick on it.

docs.title: Come back
docs.text: At 9th level, you gain the following Force trick. It doesn't count against the number of Force tricks you know. This Trick need to consume 4 Force Dice to be used. Trick | Casting time | Effect -----------------------------|--------------|-------- Come back to your loved ones | 1 minute | You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This magic can’t return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

docs.title: Come back (NightSisters)
docs.text: At 9th level, you gain the following Force trick. It doesn't count against the number of Force tricks you know. This Trick need to consume 4 Force Dice to be used. Trick | Casting time | Effect -----------------------------|--------------|-------- Come back to your master | 1 minute | You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. The body rises and returns to artificial life for 1 Force Die hours. The creature is visibly corrupted and resembles an empty shell. The creature follows your orders. You can have only one of these undead creatures at a time.

docs.title: Allya Song
docs.text: At 15th level, when you have to make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring back to your feet, singing with a burst of powerful energy. You regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum, and then you stand up if you so choose. Each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you takes force damage equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier, and is charmed until the end of the current turn.

docs.title: Night Song (NightSisters)
docs.text: At 15th level, when you have to make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring back to your feet, singing with a burst of cursed energy. You regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum, and then you stand up if you so choose. Each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you takes necrotic damage equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier, and is frightened until the end of the current turn.

docs.title: Technician: Droid Specialist
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Improved Droid
docs.text:
Beginning when you choose this specialty at 3rd level, you spend time working on your droid companion. You can now give upgrades to your droid. The droid can have an amount of upgrades equal to your proficiency modifier. You can replace an upgrade by another one once during a long rest where you don't repair your droid.

Upgrade Effect Reinforced Plate Give +1 to the droid AC. This upgrade can be applied multiple times. Smaller Vital Components Increase the droid constitution by 2. This upgrade can be applied multiple times. Repairability Index: 10 When repairing your droid, roll a d8 instead of a d6. Thrusters Give the droid a 20ft fly speed. Propulsion Increase the droid walk speed by 10ft. Exterminate Increase the Zapzap instruction damage by 1d6. Advanced Scanner When using the Scanning instruction, the affected creatures lose 1 AC until the end of your turn. Farsighted Droid Add two additional uses of emergency stim. This upgrade can be applied multiple times. Opposable Thumbs The droid can hold and use a blaster with the Light property. It uses Intelligence for attack rolls. It replaces one of your attacks. Grenade Launcher The droid can throw grenades you are equipped with. The throwing range increases by 10 ft. It uses your gadget points. It replaces one of your attacks. Copilot The droid can connect to a vehicle interface to add your intelligence modifier to pilot rolls.

docs.title: Emergency Protocol
docs.text:
At 6th level, you setup an emergency protocol for your droid. The emergency protocol trigger when the droid Hit Points drop to 0. Once the emergency protocol triggered, it don't happen again until you've repaired the droid during a rest.

Choose one option among those three : - Last stand: The droid recover 1 hit points - Mutual destruction: The droid explodes, except if you are in range. Every creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier). On a failure, the creature takes a number of d10 fire damage equal to your proficiency modifier, or half the damage on a success. Set the droid's Hit Points to -12. - Protection: The droid emits an ionic dome with a radius of 10 feet and with Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier * your proficiency bonus.

docs.title: Synchronization
docs.text: At 9th level, whenever you attack a creature, your droid can attack (Zapzap, Opposable Thumbs, Grenade Launcher) the same target for free. You can use this feature once each turn.

docs.title: My Friend
docs.text: At 14th level, if your droid falls to 0 Hit Points, you have advantage on attack rolls against the creature that deals the damage until the end of combat. If you fall to 0 HitPoints, you can give on last instruction to your droid, it can be to flee, or to attack the creature that deals the damage. The droid has advantage on attack rolls until the end of the combat.

docs.title: What would I do without it?
docs.text: At 18th level, whenever your droid is within 10ft from you, you get a bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier to any ability check or saving throw.

docs.title: Technician: Hacking Specialist
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Protocol hijacking
docs.text:
Beginning when you choose this specialty at 3rd level, you obtain a hacking device, such as a tablet, a watch, or a lens in your helmet. Using an action with this device you can load Protocols in a computer or droid (turrets are considered as droids) in a 30ft range. You have to make a Science ability check for the Protocol to succeed (the DC depends on the target). You know a number of Protocols equal to your proficiency bonus, and using one costs 1 Gadget Point.

Protocol Target Effect 1 Droid The target uses its reaction to run away from you using all its speed. It doesn't recover it at the start of its next turn. 4 Computer The target emits visible short circuits, sounds, or other harmless effects (depending on the machine and your choice), causing a distraction within a 30-foot range. 15 Door You force a door to open, close, or lock it. 22 Droid You wipe memories up to 24h in the past. 42 Any You overload the system with a complex problem, making it inactive for 10 minutes or until it takes damage. 66 Droid The target becomes hostile to its allies until the end of its next turn. 67 Droid The target taunt creatures in a 30ft range, making diversion and occasionally turning them hostile to it. 69 Droid The target becomes friendly to you for 1 minute, or until it takes damage.

The same droid can be affected by the same Protocol only once until a long rest.

docs.title: ECM Jammer
docs.text:
At 6th level, you tinkered a special device. When activated every machines in your hacking range capable of seeing or communicating remotely lose these capabilities. The ECM Jammer emit this effect for 1 minute. Once you use the ECM Jammer, you can't use it again until a long rest.

Moreover, your hacking range increases to 40 feet.

docs.title: Blackout
docs.text:
At 9th level, EMP grenades cost you one less gadget point, and you recover the use of your ECM Jammer on a short rest.

Moreover, your hacking range increases to 50 feet.

docs.title: Homemade Technology
docs.text:
At 14th level, your Protocols and EMP grenade DC are increased by 1d4.

Moreover, your hacking range increases to 60 feet.

docs.title: Multi-tasking
docs.text:
At 18th level, your Protocols can be loaded to two targets at once.

Moreover, your hacking range increases to 100 feet.

docs.title: Force Sensitive: Knight
docs.text:
You learnt to make the Force of your blood work with the force of your body.

Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Martial training
docs.text: You gain proficiency with medium common armors, all classic shields, small ionic shields, common military weapons and all grenades. Choose one fighting style from the Soldier class.

docs.title: Strengthened Force
docs.text: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, the "Boomerang" trick is no more restricted to light weapons.

docs.title: Knight's Accelerated trick
docs.text: At 9th level, after making an attack, you can use a Force trick as a bonus action.

docs.title: Reinforced Strength
docs.text: At 15th level, whenever you make a roll using your Strength, you can consume one Force Die and add it to the result.

docs.title: Soldier: Medic
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Medicine PhD
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with medikits, defibrillators, and stim pistols. You also gain proficiency with Medicine if you are not already proficient with. Moreover, when you roll dice to heal a target, you treat 1 as 2.

docs.title: Walking Ambulance
docs.text: At 7th level, healing stims and medikit cost you one less gadget point to use.

docs.title: Homemade recipe
docs.text: At 10th level, your healing stim also cures common diseases and poisons. Moreover, it gives one turn of Pain Inhibited and +1d4 to the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

docs.title: Concentrated Injection
docs.text: At 15th level, your healing stims and medikit heal for one additional d8. Moreover, when rolling a Medicine check to use a medikit, you treat 1 as 2.

docs.title: Guardian angel
docs.text: At 18th level, whenever you move toward an ally with less than half its hit points, you dodge any Overwatch or opportunity attacks if they can miss. Moreover, when you return a creature to 1 hit point, it can roll a number of Hit Dice equal to your proficiency bonus and regain that many hit points. The creature does not lose those Hit Dice, but can't benefit from this feature until a long rest.

docs.title: Soldier: Officer
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Leader
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you become able to give instructions, advice, or encouragement to your allies, according to your management methods. As a bonus action, you can give an ally a 1d6 bonus to their next attack roll or saving throw. You can use this feature four times between each long rest.

docs.title: Dew it
docs.text: You prefer giving orders to following them. At 7th level, you can use a bonus action to order an ally who can hear you to attack a target you can see. If the ally is willing, they can make one free attack against the target. You cannot give an order to an ally using overwatch or barrage fire. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus between two short rests.

docs.title: Inspiring commander
docs.text: Whether you inspire fear, respect, or hope, it remains a source of motivation. At 10th level, the attacks triggered by your At my command feature benefit from your charisma modifier to the attack roll. Moreover you gain two more uses of your Leader feature.

docs.title: Officer is always right
docs.text: At 15th level, the attacks triggered by your At my command feature benefit from your charisma modifier to the damage roll. Moreover, you gain advantage on Persuasion checks about strategy.

docs.title: Coat of medals
docs.text: All your victories are pinned to your clothes and you should think about wearing a bigger hat to create more space. At 18th level, you gain expertise with Persuasion and Intimidation. Moreover you gain two more uses of your Leader feature.

docs.title: Voyager: Phantom
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Fast Hands
docs.text: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your Hacking Tool to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action. Moreover, you have advantage on ability checks to unlock a door or chest.

docs.title: In the Shadows
docs.text: At 9th level, you become proficient with Infiltrator Suit. Moreover, your footsteps don't make a sound while you are not wearing medium or heavy armor.

docs.title: Second-Story Work
docs.text:
At 13th level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement.

In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

docs.title: Thief's Reflexes
docs.text: At 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.

docs.title: Voyager: Pirate
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Strategic Retreat
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain special abilities when piloting a spaceship. If the spaceship didn't attack since your last turn, its AC increases by your Charisma modifier. Moreover, you need one less turn to enter hyperspace.

docs.title: Loathsome opponent
docs.text: At 3rd level, you can use your bonus action to insult someone within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier and have disadvantage on its next attack roll.

docs.title: Throat or Treats
docs.text: At 9th level, you have advantage on Intimidation checks to obtain a good deal.

docs.title: Rakish Audacity
docs.text:
At 13th level, your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier.

You also gain an additional way to use your Sneak Attack; you don't need advantage on the attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.

docs.title: Master duelist
docs.text: At 17th level, your mastery of the combat lets you turn failure into success. If you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once you do so, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

docs.title: Bounty Hunter: Poisoner
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Poisoner kit
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with stim pistols. Your healing stim and regenerating stim deal poison or acid damage (choose when you use it) instead of healing. Moreover, your gas grenades can deal acid damage instead of poison damage and use your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Reversed metabolism
docs.text: At 3rd level, your countless experiments on yourself with poisons and chemicals have modified your metabolism. Healing effects deal damage to you, but poison damage heals you. You are also resistant to acid and immune to poisoning.

docs.title: Side Effects
docs.text: At 6th level, when a creature is affected by one of your poisoned stims, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

docs.title: Rabbit Hole
docs.text: At 9th level, you’ve read and watched everything there is to see about poisons and venomous creatures. You know if a creature is venomous and you have advantage on Animal Handling checks with them. Moreover, your poison and acid damage ignore resistances.

docs.title: Arsenic pudding
docs.text: The thing you love about poisons is that when you mix together just about any dangerous substances, the effect is always brutal. At 11th level, all your poison and acid damage is increased by your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Ultimate Poison
docs.text: At 17th level, your poison damage ignores immunity, and any poisoning effect you inflict lasts for one more turn.

docs.title: Soldier: Purifier
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Pyromaniac
docs.text: You are not a pyromaniac, you just love fire and the fires that break out after you pass by are just a coincidence. Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with flamethrowers and hand flamethrowers. Moreover, the fire damage you deal is increased by your Charisma modifier, even to yourself (but you like it). If you use a jetpack, you automatically know the Scorching Landing maneuver. Those kinds of things are natural to you.

docs.title: The smell of napalm in the morning
docs.text: At 7th level, your flamethrowers and incendiary grenade use a special liquid, preventing the target to stop Burning by using an action. Moreover any Burning you inflict last for one more turn.

docs.title: Fire of joy
docs.text: At 10th level, seeing people burn makes you happy, and also terrifying. For each person with the Burning within 30 feet of you, you gain a +1 temporary bonus to your Charisma.

docs.title: Wookie knightmare
docs.text: At 15th level, you improve your secret recipe, and any Burning you inflict last fo another additional turn. Additionally, even if a target succeeds against your attempt to ignite them, they still get one turn (and no more) of Burning.

docs.title: Some people want to watch the world burn...
docs.text: ...and you are one of them. At 18th level, the fire damage you deal is now increased by your Charisma modifier * 2, and your flamethrowers and incendiary grenades gain 5 feet of range.

docs.title: Soldier: Sharpshooter
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Uncanny eye
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with all precision rifles. Moreover your ranged attacks ignore the enemy half cover.

docs.title: Steady Aim
docs.text: At 3rd level, as a bonus action, you give yourself a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this bonus action only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use the bonus action, your speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

docs.title: Patient Shot
docs.text: At 7th level, when you take your time, you never miss. If you miss, that means you didn't take enough time. When attacking with any precision rifle, you can consume any remaining extra attacks to empower your current attack with +5 to hit and one more damage die for each consumed extra attack.

docs.title: Calculated shot
docs.text: At 10th level, you can shoot with your range weapons at their max range without disadvantage. This also improves the range of your overwatch attacks.

docs.title: Overcalculated shot
docs.text: At 15th level, the increasingly difficult shots have shaped your brain and your instinct. Through your lens, your eyes discern the geometry of the world—every straight line, every angle, every mathematical theorem you were convinced you had forgotten. Whenever you use a precision rifle, if you know the position of a target, you can try a shot with a bounce to hit it. Your attack roll against hit will have a penalty of -10. This attack ignores directional protections such as shields and cover.

docs.title: Picky shooter
docs.text: At 18th level, the question is no longer "will you hit," but "where will you hit ?". Whenever you make an attack with a precision rifle, you can aim for specific parts of the target, such as: - its weapon to disarm it (no damage) - its eyes to blind it - its leg to halve its speed You can also aim at small targets such as a remote or a light bulb without disadvantage.

docs.title: Voyager: Smuggler
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: The Basics
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you are very good at hiding things, when you hide something you add your Charisma modifier to the DC to find it. Moreover, when taking the Dash action or Cunning action, you don't trigger overwatch attacks.

docs.title: Familiar Territory
docs.text:
You had your routine, traveling between the same locations. When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you are particularly familiar with one type of natural environment and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions. Choose one type of favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the caves. When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check related to your favored terrain, your proficiency bonus is doubled if you are using a skill that you’re proficient in.

While traveling for an hour or more in your favored terrain, you gain the following benefits: - Difficult terrain doesn’t slow your group’s travel. - Your group can’t become lost except by magical means. - Even when you are engaged in another activity while traveling (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking), you remain alert to danger. - When you forage, you find twice as much food as you normally would. - While tracking other creatures, you also learn their exact number, their sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area.

docs.title: Bargaining
docs.text: At 9th level, you add 1d4 to any Charisma check about trading something or hiding the truth.

docs.title: Secret Route
docs.text: At 13th level, your experience makes you able to find alternative routes through space to avoid dangers such as blockades, customs, natural hazards, or battlefields.

docs.title: Bluff
docs.text: At 17th level, when you get caught doing something forbidden, you have advantage on any Charisma check to get through it. Even if the creature that surprises you would attack on sight, yet you still have the option to attempt a bluff.

docs.title: Bounty Hunter: Specialist
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Charisma modifier.

docs.title: Phoenix training
docs.text: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency with precision rifles, Mandalorian vambraces, and jetpacks, and you have two uses of the jetpack between two short rests.

docs.title: Armor modifications
docs.text:
At 3rd level, you learn to modify your armor to integrate specialized equipment into it. During a long rest, you can integrate a number of pieces of equipment equal to your Intelligence modifier, provided you have the equipment. You can also swap two pieces of equipment. Each part of your armor can hold one modification at a time, and you can have a total number of modifications equal to your proficiency bonus. You are proficient with any integrated device. Integrated equipment only needs a bonus action to activate (except for melee weapons). Integrated equipment can have a benefit or a penalty compared to when it is not integrated.

You know a number of Modifications equal to your proficiency bonus. Whenever this number increases, choose a new Modification from the Specialist Modifications list.

docs.title: Jetpack Maneuver
docs.text:
At 6th level, you learn one jetpack maneuver among the list below. Moreover you gain a third use of the jetpack between two short rests.

Maneuver Requirement to use it Description Reactor Strike 12 Strength After flying for at least 10 feet, if you directly make a melee attack, the damage is increased by 2d6. Scorching landing After flying with your jetpack, you can choose to land (losing all the remaining flying speed) and burst fire in a 5-foot radius. All creatures (except you) in this area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or receive Burning for one turn. Flood of fire A ranged weapon without the Surgical property You can use your action and one use of your jetpack to rise and rain down fire in a 10-foot radius. Roll your weapon's damage once. Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes the full damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage from a burst weapon is rolled once. The weapon's overheat increases by the maximum amount of its cooling action. Brutal landing 12 Constitution After flying with your jetpack, you can choose to land (losing all the remaining flying speed) and burst fire in a 5-foot radius. All creatures (except you) in this area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. Reflex Dodge 12 Dexterity If you are in the area of an explosion or other similar effects, you can use your reaction and one use of your jetpack to fly out from the danger. You only move to the closest safe area. Clearance You can use a use of your jetpack to give you +5 to your next saving throw against any restraining condition.

docs.title: Armor Expert
docs.text: At 11th level, you empower your integrated devices. Your Armor Modifications now use the Improved property shown in each Modification's description.

docs.title: War Machine
docs.text: At 17th level, you can apply two Modifications to each armor part. Moreover, every Modification that uses Gadget Points costs 1 less (minimum 1).

docs.title: Technician: Tinkerer Specialist
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Armorer
docs.text: You gain proficiency with medium and heavy armors and all armors and shields.

docs.title: Jack of all Forges
docs.text:
Beginning when you choose this specialty at 3rd level, you learn multiple Modifications you can apply to weapons and armor. During a long rest, using Tinkerer's tools, you can apply a number of Modifications equal to your proficiency bonus. When trying to apply a Modification, make a Tinker's tools roll against a DC of 12 + 4 for each Modification already present on the object. On a failure, you lose one attempt.

Modification Type Effect Joint Clearance Armor Remove the disadvantage on Stealth of an armor but reduce the AC by one. Bulky Armor Increase the AC by one, but reduce dexterity by two. Additional pockets Armor Increase the number of Gadget Points by your Intelligence modifier. Thermal Goggles Armor Attach these goggles to the helmet. The user don't need proficiency to use them. Excludes other goggles. Night-vision Goggles Armor Attach these goggles to the helmet. The user don't need proficiency to use them. Excludes other goggles. Legs Exoskeleton Armor Increase the walking speed by 5ft. Arms Exoskeleton Armor Add melee damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. Zapzap Weapon Add the Shocking property to a weapon. Ionic Weapon Add ionic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. Igniter Weapon Add fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. Zooming Scope Range weapon You don't have disadvantage on your shoots outside the base range. Silencer Blaster Reduce the emitted sound when shooting to 15 feet. The laser shots also become less bright. Battery Blaster Increase the blaster max overheat by 50%. Nitrogen Condensator Blaster Increase the active cooling by 1 (no effect if original cooling is 1).

You can apply one Modification by weapon or armor. You can apply two at 9th level and three at 18th level. You can't apply the same Modification multiple times on the same object.

docs.title: That's just a moving armor
docs.text: At 6th level, you can use your armorer skills to improve your droid companion defenses. Your droid companion gain AC equal to your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Flash of Genius
docs.text: At 9th level, you've gained the ability to come up with solutions under pressure. When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

docs.title: The Right Tool for the Job
docs.text: At 14th level, you've learned how to produce exactly the tool you need. With Tinkerer's tools in hand and enough scrap around you, you can create a gadget or tool. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work, which can coincide with a short or long rest. The resulting object remains a makeshift creation, thus it is destroyed after on use, but this use is free (no Gadget Points).

docs.title: Master gunsmith
docs.text:
At 18th level, your Modifications are improved as following.

Modification Type Improvement Joint Clearance Armor No more AC reduction. Bulky Armor No more Dexterity reduction Additional pockets Armor Increase again the number of Gadget Points by your Intelligence modifier. Thermal Goggles Armor The user gets +2 on attacks against an enemy blinded by smoke when using these goggles. Night-vision Goggles Armor The user gets +2 on attacks against an enemy blinded by darkness when using these goggles. Legs Exoskeleton Armor Now Increase the walking speed by 10ft. Arms Exoskeleton Armor Add 1d4 to melee damage. Zapzap Weapon Add 1d4 lightning damage. Ionic Weapon Add 1d4 ionic damage. Igniter Weapon Add 1d4 fire damage. Zooming Scope Range weapon Add 1d4 to the attack rolls. Silencer Blaster Now reduce the emitted sound when shooting to 10 feet. The laser shots become almost transparent. Battery Blaster Now Increase the blaster max overheat by 100%. Nitrogen Condensator Blaster Now Increase the active cooling by 2 (or 1 if original cooling is 1).

docs.title: Bounty Hunter: Trapper
docs.text: Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Improvised trap
docs.text: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn to construct a trap from a grenade. Using Tinker's tools and a grenade, you can place a trap (wire trap, mine, etc.). When triggered, the trap creates the grenade's effects. You are proficient with Tinkering Tools.

docs.title: Discreet assembly
docs.text: At 6th level, your traps become less visible. Enemies have a penalty on their Perception checks to detect them equal to your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Sabotage
docs.text: At 9th level, you become able to sabotage some machines. Using Tinker's tools, you can target a machine within 5 feet and make a Sleight of Hand check (the DC depends on the target). On a success, choose one of the following two effects: - Deactivates the machine - The next time a creature tries to interact with it, it takes a number of d8 lightning damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

docs.title: Electric Cage
docs.text: At 11th level, you created a unique trap. Using an action, you place it in a 5ft range from you. When a creature steps on it, the cage unfolds and traps the creature, dealing it 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier lightning damage and making it drop any weapon in its hands. The cage stays active for a number of hours equal to your Intelligence modifier. A creature trying to touch the cage takes 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier lightning damage. The cage can be destroyed by shooting precisely on the system.

docs.title: Rapid Triggering
docs.text: At 17th level, the DC of your traps is increased by 1d4.

docs.title: Force Sensitive: Wizard
docs.text:
You use the Force instinctively, and you have always been ahead of the curve in your progress.

Your equipment uses your Wisdom modifier.

docs.title: Talented
docs.text: Whenever you roll a Force Die, you treat 1 as 2. Additionally, your Force abilities' range is increased to 40 feet.

docs.title: Midichlorian-rich blood
docs.text: At 5th level, you gain additional Force Dies equal to your proficiency bonus. Moreover, you can choose one more Force Trick.

docs.title: Wizard's Upgraded trick
docs.text: At 9th level, you can consume an additional Force Die to modify a Force trick between the following two options: - use a Force Trick that normally needs an action with a bonus action instead. - use a Force Trick on two targets at a time instead of one. This consumed Force Die doesn't amplify the Trick's DC or damage.

docs.title: Meditation
docs.text: At 15th level, You can spend ten minutes meditating to recover Force Dies: roll a Force Die (without consuming one) and regain as many Force Dies as the result. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you take a long rest.
